round1: Jaclyn led a bigger, eight-person Round 1 with 23 points, the only one to nail Chicago in six, while Derrick propped up the bottom with 11. Stephanie was the only one to nail Montreal's sweep of Tampa in four.
round2: Newcomer Jamie took Round 2 with 20 points, jumping from seventh to second, and was the only person to nail Los Angeles in seven. Nathan finished with just 6 after picking Boston and Anaheim, both wrong.
round3: Nathan nailed both the Rangers in six and the Kings in seven, scoring 24 points to leap into the lead. He was also the only one of eight to pick the Rangers over Montreal, and the other seven are still thinking about it.
round4: Ryan and Stephanie both nailed Los Angeles in five for 15 points each, with Ryan almost catching Nathan, who had taken the Kings in six for 4. Jaclyn, Jamie, Marc and Nickall all took the Rangers and scored nothing.
overall: Nathan won again with 55 points, edging Ryan (54) by a single point, which is as close as this pool gets. Nickall finished last at 25, his second time at the bottom, and for the third straight pool he had the lowest conference finals score. Nathan, Ryan and Stephanie all picked the Kings to win the Cup, just as they did in 2012, and it worked both times.
